Then rehash/reread changed evidence, resolve the manifest baseline, obtain authorized corpus/load/targets and foundation readiness, assign the four integration requests (or accepted equivalent dependency contracts) because CI-014 sharedPatchPaths is empty. risks: Scope cannot by itself deliver AC-4: doc/tool/test files do not wire product fallback. Accepted dependency or lead-owned orchestration is necessary, not an optional follow-up.
Root wave0 integration can change refs/provider hashes or the future local-search API; input_revision alone does not freeze the dirty working tree.
Provider metadata revision/digest shape and readiness strings are not public API, license, retention or runtime proof. Repogrep automation must remain disabled.
Receipt-bound egress allow is not live authorization. Revocation during search and after provider failure can otherwise expose protected source.
Raw FTS spans/snippets are workspace-wide, not caller-filtered, revision-pinned search evidence; filtering only after LIMIT can distort recall and authorization.
FTS OR versus LIKE AND term semantics and caps must not be presented as equivalent precision. total currently counts returned rows, not all matches.

walkSourceTree's body-character slicing does not set truncated, its nominal hidden-file branch contains no continue, and traversal bounds apply per root. This source traversal must not replace the accepted repository exclusion/coverage resolver or be assumed complete.
isSourceIndexFtsAvailable/status TS fts reports constructor availability rather than a verified FTS5 table; fail-soft empty hits can mask unavailable SQLite under Node/Electron.
Existing watcher silently caps roots/skips unwatchable roots and carries no snapshot revision; freshness needs accepted CI-008 identity/restart reconciliation, not mtime/event presence.

No load/motivation, provider contract, real benchmark or runtime acceptance was observed. Every unimplemented criterion remains GAP_BLOCKS_COMPLETION; conditional service choice cannot become a fabricated N/A or PASS.

Do not add permanent tests of source text, inventory copies or transport mock echoes; outage tests must assert exact consumer-visible search/authority/boundary behavior and the real service lane must be separately exercised when used.
